stories.headline: HFCL Q2 Results: Profit zooms 448% YoY to Rs 394 crore; stock hits 5% upper circuit

Revenue surged 144% to Rs 2,542 crore, while EBITDA rose 224% to Rs 658 crore. EBITDA margin expanded 640 basis points to 25.89%. The optical fibre and AI beneficiary’s stock hit the 5% upper circuit at Rs 268.70 on the BSE and has gained nearly 300% so far this year.
